o.norm: Takes an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding. @param testValues an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding.

i.norm:
Verifies that names which sound alike collapse to the same NYSIIS code.

The two spellings "Trueman" and "Truman" are phonetically equivalent, so the default (strict) NYSIIS encoder must reduce both to the canonical code "TRANAN".
